raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (10–14 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild foundational strength and movement quality postpartum"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Reconnect — Breath and Bracing":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x4 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x4 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Reconnect — Gentle Load":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x4 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 30m "Reconnect — Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x5 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m

    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Build — Lower Body Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x5 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x5 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Build — Upper Body Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x5 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 35m "Build — Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m

    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Progress — Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Progress — Upper Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 40m "Progress — Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m

    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Consolidate — Lower Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Consolidate — Upper Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Consolidate — Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2m

goals.name: Rebuild foundational strength and movement quality postpartum
